posts.name: Letter Visitors
posts.tagline: See website visitors on your website itself
posts.description: Know who’s on your website: the people, their companies, and the AI agents reading your pages. See them on your own site, and replay their sessions.

posts.name: Gauth Personal Study Agent
posts.tagline: An AI study agent that remembers where you struggle
posts.description: Gauth Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, the quizzes you take, and the topics you study into one ongoing picture of how you learn. Instead of starting from scratch each session, it spots the gap behind a mistake, builds a short daily plan around it, and adjusts that plan when you miss a review or master a topic early. Practice comes as flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes, with topic mastery and streaks to show progress. Built into the Gauth app.

posts.name: Motionflare
posts.tagline: Turn your website into a stunning launch video in minutes
posts.description: Motionflare turns your website into a ready-to-share marketing video and brand film in minutes. Paste a URL and it uses your real product screenshots, logo, colors, and copy to create branded motion graphics with music and optional narration. Or switch to Film mode to generate a live-action commercial. Refine the result by chat and export in up to 4K.

posts.name: Dog Translator SuperTranslator
posts.tagline: Dogs talking in English (real)
posts.description: What if your dog could tell you what they're feeling? SuperTranslator uses AI to read your dog's body language, vocalizations and interactions with their surroundings, and turns those signals into plain English. Instead of random phrases from barks, it looks at several behavioral cues at once to help you understand what your dog might be communicating. According to our benchmarks, this is the most accurate dog translation in history.

posts.name: Modem
posts.tagline: Find, fix, and follow up on every customer concern
posts.description: Modem monitors your customer channels (support tickets, group chat, sales calls) and alerts you to problems within minutes. It can automatically open an issue, spin up a coding agent, or escalate to the right team. When the fix ships, it closes the loop with your customers. Never lose track of a request again.

posts.name: Polylane Swarms
posts.tagline: A team of AI agents on your roughest production incidents
posts.description: Put a swarm of agents on your massive production incidents. Agents investigate possible causes in parallel, share evidence and check each other's findings. You get one answer with the root cause, the evidence and a proposed fix.

posts.name: Inkling 2 Mini
posts.tagline: 26B looped model for coding on your laptop
posts.description: Inkling 2 Mini is Thinking Machines' 26.4B open-weight model built for local agentic work. Its middle transformer layers run three times per token, adding reasoning depth without extra weights. It runs on 32GB Macs through Ollama.

posts.name: Chat with Work
posts.tagline: AI bots in Europe. They work. You decide.
posts.description: Create a bot with a single sentence. It works for you. Create as many as you need. They start by themselves and work across 1,920+ integrations with your laptop closed. When there's a decision to take, they ask you. Every question and approval from all your bots lands in one place. You just decide. Claude Duet: US only. ChatGPT's dots: not on Pro or Plus in Europe. Gemini's Tasks: not in Europe. Not us. Chat with Work's bots run in the EU, on every plan. 300 trial credits, no card.

posts.name: Hydrilla
posts.tagline: Generate production-ready 3D assets with AI
posts.description: Hydrilla AI generates high-quality 3D assets from simple prompts. Designed for game developers, animation studios, and XR creators, it helps teams create production-ready models in minutes instead of days. Build faster pipelines for games, films, and immersive worlds.

posts.name: Journalistic Tech
posts.tagline: Async interviews that get you published on HackerNoon
posts.description: Tell us what you do or what just happened. We match you to one of 273 technology interviews. Answer ~13 questions by voice or text, on your own time. Your answers become a bylined draft, an editor reviews and polishes it, then it publishes on HackerNoon and gets distributed around the web.

posts.name: Tesla Self-Driving V15
posts.tagline: Upgrading every part of the end-to-end driving network
posts.description: What's new in FSD V15: • 25x better handling of safety-critical cases • Tesla Reality View: a live generative view from a virtual camera above your car, so you see and control what FSD plans • Fullscreen, map, split or quiet mode • Nav turns in the visualization; quieter turn signals • Trip start/end routing learned from fleet route preferences • Better detection of signs, animals, debris, potholes and standing water; smoother speed in school zones and bad weather

posts.name: LeanTake
posts.tagline: 4.1 MB native Mac screen recorder — zero export wait
posts.description: Pure Swift + ScreenCaptureKit screen recorder for macOS 15+ (Apple Silicon). Real-time hardware encoding writes finishedmov videos the second you hit Stop. Includes a 12-color live pen, region magnifier, 9 3D cat paw cursors, and a window-excluded stealth teleprompter. Free forever (no watermark, no login); optional Pro $14.99 one-time.

posts.name: Plango
posts.tagline: Plango lets your AI agents work all night - safely
posts.description: AI is wreaking havoc in cybersecurity. You need a command center to protect your device and AI-agent setup. There are two major risks today: 1. External AI attackers finding exploits 2. Internal AI taking unsafe actions Plango researches and patches vulnerabilities while running entirely on-device. It finds where you're vulnerable and shows how to fix it. (example: you may be vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks due to SSL certs compromised in October. Plango shows if you have them!)

posts.name: Strict
posts.tagline: Run GitHub Actions on any spare Mac or Linux machine
posts.description: Turn spare Macs and Linux boxes into a self-healing, auto load-balancing GitHub Actions fleet at $0/min compute. Includes a native macOS Liquid Glass app, 7-tier disk cleanup, preflight doctor, and Tailscale-native setup—zero account required.

posts.name: naturefunding.org
posts.tagline: Grants for nature projects, checked against funder pages
posts.description: A free directory of 1,000+ grants for nature restoration and conservation: forests, coasts, wetlands, wildlife and more. Every deadline, amount and eligibility rule links to the funder's own page, with its exact words and the date we checked it. Filter by place, deadline, who can apply and how to apply (directly, through a partner, or invitation only). No paid listings, no sign-up. Data is open (CC BY 4.0) as JSON, CSV and an Atom feed.

posts.name: Omi Work
posts.tagline: Omi can build anything. Now it finds your next 100 customers
posts.description: Omi can build anything. Omi Work is an AI workspace for the hardest, longest jobs. Give it a goal: it shows the plan first, splits big work across sub-agents, searches the web, uses the apps you connect, keeps going after you close the tab, and hands back documents, sheets with formulas and slide decks. Ready-made teammates, scheduled tasks and voice mode. Teams get roles, SSO and an audit log. Free to start, no card.

posts.name: Replit Missions
posts.tagline: Set a budget, coordinate teams of AI agents,
posts.description: Turn ambitious goals into outcomes with Replit Missions. Set a budget, coordinate teams of AI agents, and review progress against clear success criteria.

posts.name: freddy
posts.tagline: Private health data server: talk to your health with any AI
posts.description: freddy is your health data server. Connect your wearables, rings, glucose monitors, training apps, Apple Health and Health Connect once, and add your lab results. freddy keeps every value as the source sends it. Use it with any AI, export it, or build on it.

posts.name: Othor AI
posts.tagline: Your Head of Intelligence. Know what your numbers are hiding
posts.description: Othor AI is a new species of business intelligence, built on the tradecraft of intelligence agencies and a century of signal analysis. Automated statistical intelligence for business leaders: more signal, faster decisions, with the smallest possible AI bill and the least human effort. AI drafts the words; code computes every number, and any night can be replayed byte for byte. Open source (Apache-2.0); hosted or on your servers.

posts.name: Ashwa
posts.tagline: Your AI companion that never forgets what you say
posts.description: Come back after 100 days, and Ashwa can still recall relevant details from your past conversations and diary entries. Pick up where you left off without repeating your story. Talk through your day, reflect in a private daily journal, and get responses shaped by the emotional context you've shared

posts.name: Snowly
posts.tagline: Plan ski trips with friends. Remember every run.
posts.description: Snowly is a ski and snowboard app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Plan trips with friends, see your crew on the trail map, check the snow before you go, and let Snowly record every run on its own. Each day lands in your ski passport. Free, with no ads.

posts.name: Spikely
posts.tagline: Startup Metric Alerts for iPhone, Mac and Apple Watch
posts.description: Spikely watches Stripe, Vercel, PostHog and 16 more tools, learns what’s normal for every number, and alerts you the minute one breaks pattern, with the deploy, error or referrer behind it. Every startup’s sales, live in one app.

posts.name: Orpheus
posts.tagline: Run all your Claude subscriptions from one place
posts.description: Orpheus puts every Claude subscription you pay for on one board: weekly and 5-hour usage, forecast and reset. Move idle agents to the account with room, answer agents on every machine, and open Rooms where your team and your agents chat together.

posts.name: Mobile Agent Testers
posts.tagline: Free open-source AI agents that beta-test your app on phones
posts.description: No test scripts. Each tester is an AI agent with its own Android emulator or iOS Simulator on GitHub Actions, playing a persona: iPhone SE in Swedish at the largest text size, Pixel 7 at 200%, iPad in German, Arabic right to left. It uses your app like a new user and writes a bug report with screenshots, then one summary groups the duplicates. Open source. Flutter, React Native, Expo, Kotlin, Swift, KMP, Capacitor,NET MAUI, or a prebuilt APK.

posts.name: ExtraBar
posts.tagline: Build a custom menu bar for your Mac
posts.description: Your Mac menu bar fills up with icons you never click, while the things you do every day stay buried in menus. ExtraBar lets you build a menu bar around the apps you actually use.

posts.name: Open Source Solana Wallet
posts.tagline: Your own keys, your very own network
posts.description: A Solana wallet for iPhone and iPad with no backend. It connects directly to the RPC you choose: public Solana RPC, a provider with your own key, or any HTTPS URL. - Private balances for SOL, USDC, and USDT - Only the tokens you add, so no spam - Prices in your currency, from the built-in source, your own server, or none - Built-in themes, or build your own theme pack - Several windows on iPad and iPhone Duo - Open source

posts.name: Jot
posts.tagline: One key for everything you do with text
posts.description: Select text in any app, press one key, and Jot fixes it, translates it, summarises it or turns it into a reminder, email or Word file. Search everything you ever copied. Over 70 actions. $14.99 once, no subscription.

posts.name: MAI Image 2.7
posts.tagline: Microsoft's image model with precise edits and Canvas
posts.description: MAI Image 2.7 and MAI Image 2.7 Flash are Microsoft AI's image generation and editing models. They change an object's color, material or position without disturbing the rest, and output transparent backgrounds for logos and product images. Canvas, powered by Flash, turns prompts and sketches into editable images. Per Microsoft, 2.7 ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis image editing. Public preview on Foundry at about $35 and $10 per 1,000 images.

posts.name: FigmaMCP
posts.tagline: Let Claude Code or Codex edit your open Figma file
posts.description: A free Mac app and Figma plugin that let Claude Code or Codex read and edit the file open in Figma desktop. No Figma API token, no call quota. The app installs the plugin and connects your agent. One switch makes the file read-only.

posts.name: Branchery
posts.tagline: Branchery, a Git client for Mac
posts.description: Branchery is a Git client for Macs with Apple Silicon. It handles very large repositories, works offline and has no telemetry. Free for public repositories.

posts.name: Kopyo
posts.tagline: The Mac clipboard manager that remembers everything
posts.description: Kopyo is a native macOS clipboard manager. It saves everything you copy (text, links, images, files) and brings it back with ⇧⌘V. Search even finds the text inside screenshots, every clip remembers where it came from, and ⇥ pastes it as original, plain text or Markdown. 53 previewed transforms, a paste queue, pinboards, snippets, a CLI and AppleScript. Secrets are masked, encrypted and deleted within minutes. 7-day free trial, no account needed.

posts.name: Dreamwork
posts.tagline: The job search agent that only applies where you fit
posts.description: Dreamwork reads your resume and matches you against millions of live roles. Tap Apply and it writes a fully editable resume and cover letter for that role, then fills out the employer's application directly. Add writing samples to keep your voice. You can turn on autopilot and have it apply overnight, or you can edit each submission with granular detail. The choice is yours. Matching and tailored applications are free. No ads, and no employer can pay to rank higher.

posts.name: Paletteo
posts.tagline: Create and organize color palettes and gradients
posts.description: Paletteo is a color studio for iPhone and iPad. Create palettes and multi-stop gradients, sample colors from your camera or photos, and organize everything by project. Check contrast as you work, then export to Figma, CSS, Tailwind, or Procreate when you need it.

posts.name: RingOwl Checkin
posts.tagline: Gratitude Journal That Calls You: A Daily Check-in Call
posts.description: A gratitude journal you don't have to remember to open. RingOwl Check-in calls you at the time you pick, asks about the good parts of your day, then emails you your journal entry. Try a call in your browser. 7 days free, no card needed.

posts.name: InboxEagle
posts.tagline: Get more Klaviyo emails out of spam and into the inbox
posts.description: InboxEagle gets more of your Klaviyo emails out of spam and into the inbox. AI agents catch spam spikes, reputation drops, and blocklist hits the moment they happen. Inbox Recovery pulls spammed campaigns back to the inbox. Audience cleanup finds bots and dead profiles in Klaviyo, suppresses them, and pushes engaged segments back so your sends reach real buyers. Plus seed testing, DMARC reports, and domain monitoring to keep you there.

posts.name: Pinrom Thanks
posts.tagline: Thank a coworker on LinkedIn with a free banner
posts.description: Pinrom Thanks turns a thank-you into a LinkedIn banner with their name on it. Pick who you're thanking, choose or write a message, pick a design, and get a banner plus a link that shows it as a card when you paste it into a post. Free, no signup. New this year: ready-made messages for every kind of thank-you, one banner for your whole team, 3 modern designs, WhatsApp sharing, and a story-size image.

posts.name: Focus Bard
posts.tagline: Endless algorithmic focus music for Mac and Windows
posts.description: Focus Bard plays endless focus music, made live on your computer, not by AI. Pick one of 16 scenes, each with its own picture and sound, and stretch a string on the lute to shape the mix. Works offline on Mac and Windows. Free for 15 minutes a day.

posts.name: The Night Crew
posts.tagline: Family-friendly Futurama: a sci-fi sitcom podcast
posts.description: Three janitors. One starship. Every dirty job in the galaxy. The Night Crew is a sci-fi sitcom — radio first — about Joe, Franklin, and Mop, the night-shift cleaning crew aboard the starship S.S. Odyssey. They hate the job. They love the job. Usually in the same minute. Born as a 2013 Kickstarter pilot, now back with a full 26-episode season, a real laugh track, and a cast of voices created for the show. Episode 1 is live on Spotify and Apple Podcasts; new episodes drop Fridays.

posts.name: Loop Enrich
posts.tagline: Pay-per-result contact enrichment by Acrein Loop.
posts.description: We made this enrichment tool for anyone doing GTM, whether you’re on your own or on a team. To find someone’s email or phone number, either paste their LinkedIn profile links or enter their name and company domain. For a whole list, simply upload and map your list. We search across multiple data providers to improve your chances of a match. No login, no dashboard to learn, and no subscription. Use it whenever you need it and pay a low price for each result we find. No results, no charge.

posts.name: AI Kitchen Design
posts.tagline: See your kitchen remodeled from a photo in 30 seconds
posts.description: Wondering how new cabinets or a navy island would look in your actual kitchen? Upload a photo and AI Kitchen Design redraws the same room, from the same angle, in about 30 seconds. • 18 styles, from Japandi to Art Deco, or describe your own • Refresh, Remodel or Redesign, depending on your budget • Tweak in plain English ("make the island navy") • Before/after slider, 4K downloads, works for any room First design free, no credit card.

posts.name: Nexscope
posts.tagline: Ecommerce data & AI creative tools. All in one place.
posts.description: Nexscope brings ecommerce, marketing and social data together with AI creative tools. Research products, keywords, competitors and trends. Access data through APIs or connect it to your AI tools via MCP. Create product images, ad creatives, UGC-style videos and product videos—all in one place. Start free with 1,000 trial credits.

posts.name: EcomUp
posts.tagline: AI that runs your online shop's chats, orders and posts
posts.description: EcomUp is the AI that runs your online shop. It replies to Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp chats, takes orders, books couriers, makes product photos and reels, plans and publishes posts with Agent Mode, and runs automations and WhatsApp campaigns. AI confirmation calls coming soon. Pricing: Growth $27/mo, Scale $97/mo, Elite $147/mo, WhatsApp API Special $19/mo. Save with yearly billing or pay once for lifetime access. 14-day free trial.

posts.name: Code Sa
posts.tagline: Autonomous Code Assurance for C/C++ products
posts.description: Products depend on separate components working together. Code Sa provides a component view showing how each is used, fills testing gaps with usage-based tests, and checks every PR against your whole product specs and component contract integrations. PRs that introduce breaking changes in your product are surfaced in minutes with tests as evidence and zero false positives.

posts.name: IconJar 3
posts.tagline: Every icon you own, in one searchable library on your Mac
posts.description: IconJar keeps every icon you own in one library on your Mac. Import SVGs, icon fonts and Lottie files, find any icon in seconds, then recolor and export to any format or code. New in v3: Apple Intelligence tags, icon fonts, a local MCP server, and more…

posts.name: Onmode
posts.tagline: Photo calorie tracker & AI nutrition coach you can talk to
posts.description: Most calorie trackers log a photo now. The meals that slip through are the ones you forgot to snap. With Onmode you just tell Oni, your AI coach, what you ate: typed like a text to a friend, or out loud on a call. Oni logs the calories and macros. If a meal time passes with nothing logged, Oni sends a nudge. Photo, barcode and label logging, fasting, GLP-1, water and weight tracking are all in. Free to start on iPhone.

posts.name: Get Your Lawyers
posts.tagline: AI-Powered Legal OS for Modern Lawyers & Enterprise Firms
posts.description: Manage cases, clients and drafts in one place. AI-powered practice management software for Indian law firms and advocates. Start free today.

posts.name: BrokeCRM
posts.tagline: The free, open-source CRM your AI assistant can work in
posts.description: BrokeCRM is a free CRM for small teams: contacts, companies, a deal pipeline, notes and tasks. Forever free: no card, no trial, no per-seat price. It has a built-in MCP server, so Claude and other assistants can update it for you. Apache-2.0, on Cloudflare.

posts.name: Pixveil: Blur Video & Photo
posts.tagline: Blur faces, plates & names before you share, on-device
posts.description: Pixveil finds faces, license plates, names in screenshots, phone numbers and IBANs in your photos and videos and hides them in a few taps. Tracking follows faces through video, and you can beep any word from the transcript. Everything runs on your iPhone: nothing is uploaded, no watermark.

posts.name: Luvio: Spoken Language Lessons
posts.tagline: Learn by talking with a tutor
posts.description: Luvio is a language tutor you speak with. A lesson opens as a conversation: the tutor explains the rule, then asks you to use it. You answer out loud and hear the reply. There are no quizzes to tap through. Italian has a full course, from first sentences through advanced grammar. Each lesson teaches one rule and then puts it to work in a series of situations. Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, and more include speaking lessons and open conversation at your level.

posts.name: itogai
posts.tagline: More meetings from the relationships you already have
posts.description: itogai is the relationship intelligence platform for B2B founders, sales teams and partner programs. It scores your relationships, shows who can make the warm intro you need, and drafts the ask with Akai™. You review every message and send it yourself.

posts.name: Redline Buddy
posts.tagline: Compare Word Docs, PDFs, & Text on Mac, iPhone, iPad, or Web
posts.description: Compare two versions of a document and see what was added, deleted, and moved, in seconds. Redline Buddy reads Word, PDF, RTF, and text on Mac, iPhone, iPad, and the web. Your documents stay on your device or in your browser, never uploaded to Redline Buddy’s servers or used to train AI. Work through the changes as an issues list, save a PDF redline, or open a tracked-changes document with Microsoft Word on Mac. Paid plans start at $4.99/month.

posts.name: ModernTechLap
posts.tagline: Get recommended by AI assistants, not just Google
posts.description: When buyers ask ChatGPT or Gemini "which tool should I pick?", do they hear your name? ModernTechLap asks AI assistants the questions your buyers ask, shows who gets recommended and which sources they cite, explains why competitors win, and gives you ranked actions to fix it. Then it measures what changed. Free account: 25 buyer questions, results in about 10 minutes, no card needed.

posts.name: Synapser
posts.tagline: Email, calendars, tasks, notes & AI in one iPhone app
posts.description: Bring your plans together in one native iPhone app. Synapser connects your Google, Microsoft and Apple accounts: email, calendars, tasks and notes in one place. Find details across them, follow deliveries, and turn shared plans into AI task and event suggestions you review before adding. Available now on the App Store for iOS 27+. Subscription: $9.99/month, with a 14-day free trial for eligible new subscribers.

posts.name: Cadru
posts.tagline: Carousels, photo books & zines from your photos, via MCP
posts.description: Drop in your photos and Cadru lays them out as an Instagram carousel, a printable zine or a hardcover photo book. Edit everything yourself in the browser, or ask Claude to do it through our MCP server. Free to start, print when you're ready.

posts.name: Provado
posts.tagline: Trade calls, checked against the real price
posts.description: Analysts post trade calls every day, but who checks what happened next? Provado records each call the minute it is made, fixes the entry at the real Binance or Bybit price and lets the candles decide. Hits and misses stay public. Free to log your own.

posts.name: Bluu
posts.tagline: All-in-one CRM and dashboard for local service businesses
posts.description: Bluu is one login for everything a local service business runs on. Every inquiry from forms, chat, Facebook lead ads and bookings lands in one Leads inbox with a reply clock. Each customer gets one thread for website chat, email and text. Online booking with reminders, Google and Facebook reviews, forms, a pipeline, email and text marketing and social posting are built in. Optional AI answers your website chat and builds your site. Works on any phone. 7 days free.

posts.name: ORGOS
posts.tagline: AI-Native People Operations Platform
posts.description: ORGOS is an AI-native people-ops platform for growing teams. Handle onboarding, employee records, leave, and reviews; track monthly spending across salaries, expenses, and reimbursements; and keep tabs on equipment and software licences, all in one place. AI drafts your policies and sets up your workspace. Works with Google, Microsoft, Slack, and Teams. Free for up to 10 employees.

posts.name: Herd
posts.tagline: Brand mentions and social listening for small business
posts.description: Herd is social listening for small businesses. It finds public posts on Threads, Reddit, Instagram, X and YouTube that name your business, labels each one positive, neutral or negative, and translates any post into your language when you ask. On a paid plan, it can also draft a reply in the poster's language.

posts.name: Excaliboard
posts.tagline: Excalidraw, organized
posts.description: Excalidraw only remembers one drawing at a time. Excaliboard is a free Chrome extension that wraps the real Excalidraw editor with unlimited boards in folders, search inside every drawing, a quick switcher, 10,000+ system-design and cloud icons, Mermaid to diagram, PDF export, autosave, version history and folder backup. No account, no servers: your boards stay in your browser or in a folder you choose.

posts.name: Oran
posts.tagline: See where your Shopify store leaks revenue
posts.description: Oran compares your funnel with Littledata benchmarks from 424 Shopify stores, puts a monthly dollar figure on each leak, ranks the fixes, and tests whether a fix worked. Free checkout leak calculator. 14-day trial, no credit card.

posts.name: Oran
posts.tagline: See where your Shopify store leaks revenue
posts.description: Oran compares your funnel with Littledata benchmarks from 424 Shopify stores, puts a monthly dollar figure on each leak, ranks the fixes, and tests whether a fix worked. Free checkout leak calculator. 14-day trial, no credit card.

posts.name: Novelar
posts.tagline: programa para escribir novelas
posts.description: Escribe tu novela sin distracciones: manuscrito, personajes y escaleta en una ventana, con corrector en español o inglés. Prueba 7 días gratis.

posts.name: Jot
posts.tagline: Ideas stop dying on your phone. Your AI agent does them
posts.description: Ideas come in the shower, on the train, at 2 a.m., anywhere your computer is not. Jot it on your phone in two seconds and go on with your day. Your AI agent picks it up over MCP, does it and reports back. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. 7 day free trial.

posts.name: Qualis Insights ProductIQ
posts.tagline: Product Portfolio Management & Optimization Software
posts.description: ProductIQ helps organizations evaluate product performance, prioritize investments, and identify opportunities to grow, consolidate, reprice, or retire products using a structured portfolio management framework.

posts.name: land
posts.tagline: CI that only reruns the tests your change can reach
posts.description: land merges your coding agents' finished branches with main, tests them together, and reruns only the test commands a change can affect. It records every file each test reads, so a change to one module never waits on the whole suite. Use it from the CLI, with one line in a GitHub workflow (runs-on: land), or on your own machines. 500 free minutes a month.

posts.name: Qualis Insights ValueIQ
posts.tagline: AI ROI & AI Portfolio Management Software
posts.description: ValueIQ helps organizations track AI initiatives, measure ROI, monitor adoption, and demonstrate tangible business outcomes beyond technical activity metrics.

posts.name: FruitPop
posts.tagline: A match-3 with no lives, no timers, no ads, no account
posts.description: FruitPop is a juicy match-3 that opens in seconds and plays fully offline. Swipe, match and set off rockets, bombs and two-special combo blasts. Beat levels for up to three stars, take on a Daily Challenge where everyone plays the same board, and relax to generative ambient music that never loops. No lives, no timers, no energy, no ads, no account. Play free in your browser, or on iPhone and Android.

posts.name: WiFriends
posts.tagline: Chat to people on the same Wi-Fi
posts.description: WiFriends turns every Wi-Fi network into a chat room. Join a café, hostel, campus or train station Wi-Fi (or scan a QR code) and instantly talk to everyone there: find a study buddy, a travel mate or tonight’s plans. It works in your browser (mobile app coming soon). Stay anonymous, and messages vanish after 72 hours. Venues can own their room with Pro (€29/month or €290/year per room) to pin messages, customize colors, print QR posters, moderate and see live stats. Guests always chat free.

posts.name: Cosmic Top Secret
posts.tagline: A disclosure network for the cosmos and current events
posts.description: Cosmic Top Secret is a centralized intelligence network and forum for the cosmos, UAP, and current events. Explore Intel Files across UAP, time, teleportation, crop circles, and government disclosure, join the Alpha, and help shape the network.

posts.name: Zifurs
posts.tagline: Best For Pets
posts.description: Zifurs helps pet parents discover and book trusted veterinary clinics, grooming and spa services at affordable prices. Compare services, access exclusive discounts and cashback, purchase savings-packed pet care packages, book appointments, and manage your pet’s health records—all in one place. Making quality pet care more accessible, convenient, and affordable for every pet parent.

posts.name: Scena
posts.tagline: Your camera roll, cut into reels ready to post
posts.description: Scena is for people who want to post a good-looking reel without spending hours in an editor. Choose your photos and a look, or just pick an album, and Scena keeps the best shots and makes the reel. Sizzle goes through your camera roll and suggests trips and weekends that would make a good reel. To change something, type what you want and Director makes the edit. Scena is available on iOS and Android and is free to try.

posts.name: DrawnLocal
posts.tagline: Free Google Maps heat maps + local SEO tool for agencies
posts.description: Three free tools, no sign-up: a Google Maps heat map that shows where any business ranks street by street, an AI checker that shows if ChatGPT and Google AI Mode recommend it, and a Google rank checker. Then track it all in one app built for local SEO agencies: weekly heat maps, daily rank tracking, AI visibility, prospect finder, audits, reviews and monthly client reports. Every tool on every plan, from $29/month, cheaper than BrightLocal.

posts.name: Cully
posts.tagline: The harness runtime for software work.
posts.description: Cully is the open-source harness around Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents. Solo mode: a live advisor that flags loops, unchecked edits, and full context; private memory (Postgres + self-hosted Mem0); replay and handoff; and a scout that finds tools, skills, and hooks for your task, which you approve. Team mode: tasks owned by the team, with claims, checkpoints anyone can resume in any agent, evidence-backed review, and shared lessons. Local-first, Apache-2.0.

posts.name: Vakti.net
posts.tagline: Free booking with automatic WhatsApp reminders for clinics
posts.description: Vakti.net is an appointment-first workspace for clinics, physiotherapy practices, Pilates and yoga studios, and gyms. Set up WhatsApp confirmations, reminders, reschedules and cancellations once and Vakti sends them automatically with Meta-approved templates. Vakti.net is a Meta Tech Provider on the WhatsApp Business Platform. Online booking with booking rules, group classes and packages, one shared inbox, a password-free portal and forms. Free plan: no time limit, no card.

posts.name: Dawgin
posts.tagline: Free basketball manager in your browser, against real people
posts.description: Dawgin is a free basketball manager in your browser. Every club in one shared world is run by a person or by the AI, on a daily clock that keeps going while you are away. Call timeouts, subs and plays in live matches, sign players with moods of their own, and deal with fans, sponsors and contract talks. Every number comes with a breakdown. Watch a live match without an account; playing is free, with no pay to win.

posts.name: Panorhélie
posts.tagline: Find out which distant lands can be seen from your viewpoint
posts.description: Wondering which island, coastline or mountain range you can see from a viewpoint? Pick any place on Earth, a date and a time. Panorhélie analyses the terrain through 360°, up to 400 km away, with the Earth’s curvature, then adds the weather forecast and the Sun’s position. The map shows the lands you can hope to see, the uncertain ones and those the weather hides. Estimates, not confirmed sightings. Web app in English and French: 3 free calculations, then €0.99 once.

posts.name: QR Insights
posts.tagline: Free QR codes that never expire, plus £1.99 tracked codes
posts.description: Free UK QR code generator: no sign-up, no watermark, and codes that never expire. When you need to know if your print is working, upgrade to a tracked, editable code for £1.99 a month and see scans by day, city and device.

posts.name: TasklyFamily
posts.tagline: Make household chores fairer and more fun
posts.description: TasklyFamily makes household chores fairer and more fun. Organize tasks, assign effort-based points, spin the chore roulette, and motivate everyone with family rankings and rewards. Track participation with detailed statistics and weekly reports that suggest ways to share responsibilities more fairly. Available on Android and the web, with Alexa integration.

posts.name: Amigo Treks & Expedition
posts.tagline: Private treks & tours in Nepal, Tibet and Bhutan
posts.description: Amigo Treks & Expedition is a Kathmandu-based team that plans private treks, cultural tours, helicopter journeys and luxury trips across Nepal, Tibet and Bhutan. Compare routes and prices, shape a custom itinerary with the Trip Designer, and let the team handle permits, hotels, transport, guides and on-ground support. Rated 4.9/5 from 554 traveller reviews.

posts.name: Agent Flock
posts.tagline: Every AI coding agent, one glance away
posts.description: A notch for your Windows desktop that shows what every Claude Code and Codex agent is doing: working, needs you, done or failed. See which one is blocked on a permission prompt without hunting through windows. Read-only, fully local, no account.

posts.name: Image Maps for SharePoint
posts.tagline: Turn any image into a clickable navigation hub
posts.description: Make any image a clickable navigation system - intranet graphics, process diagrams and org charts with hotspots that open pages, documents, links or popups. No code, fully responsive, and hosted inside your own tenant. 14-day free trial.

posts.name: Superfluid
posts.tagline: Turn your devices into one local AI cluster
posts.description: Superfluid connects the computers you own into one private AI cluster. Download the app for macOS or Windows, start a network on one computer and join from the rest. Your computers want to run AI, connect them. Supports Mac, Nvidia, AMD, Intel based devices. Runs on macOS and Windows. Runs all open-weights LLM models. (Qwen4, Qwen3.8, Qwen3.6, Gemma4, Llama, Inkling Mini 2, GLM, Mistral..)

posts.name: Lockley
posts.tagline: Five UK companies to call each day, and why
posts.description: Give Lockley your web address. Every night it reads over 80 UK public sources, and every working day it hands you five companies ready for what you sell, with the reason, the source and who to ask for. It never sends anything in your name. £99 a month.

posts.name: SetGo
posts.tagline: Workouts built for your time, gear and body in seconds
posts.description: SetGo builds a workout around how long you have, the gear you own and how fit you are, in seconds. Follow it with timers and a voice coach, or build a multi-day plan that progresses. Unlimited free workouts, and you can try one without signing up.

posts.name: porthole
posts.tagline: See which project owns a port and kill it in one keystroke
posts.description: porthole shows every port listening on your machine with the project that owns it (from the nearest package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml orgit) and the Docker container behind it. Kill one in a keystroke from an animated TUI, or script it with the CLI. Every kill checks PID and start time first, sends SIGTERM, and uses SIGKILL only if it's ignored. Protected ports, watch mode, an opt-in auto-kill daemon and a local web dashboard. One Go binary for macOS, Linux and Windows. Free, MIT.

posts.name: Voella
posts.tagline: Daily voice training for people with quiet voices
posts.description: Voella is five minutes a day of breathing, voice and speaking practice for people who keep getting asked to repeat themselves. A 30-day plan that adapts to each user, live volume feedback and a weekly recording that makes progress audible. iPhone, no account.

posts.name: Marble Framer Plugin
posts.tagline: Sync your Marble content into Framer CMS in one click
posts.description: Marble's Framer plugin syncs your Marble content straight into Framer CMS. Map posts, categories, tags, authors and media to CMS fields, then import in one click. Write in Marble, design in Framer, and re-sync whenever your content changes. Free and open source.

posts.name: Tone Forge
posts.tagline: Play a modular synth on Windows and Linux
posts.description: Tone Forge is a modular synthesizer for Windows and Linux. Patch oscillators, filters, envelopes and stereo effects in an editable graph, then audition your patch with MIDI or on-screen controls. The free Community Edition includes patch editing and auditioning.

posts.name: NavPilot for SharePoint
posts.tagline: A personalised launchpad for every employee
posts.description: One navigation control centre that centralises company links, personal links and reusable AI prompts into a branded, personalised hub. 14-day free trial.

posts.name: Railflag
posts.tagline: Feature flags that pause a bad rollout on their own
posts.description: Feature flags for teams that ship daily, with OpenFeature SDKs for Node, the browser, Python, Go and Java. Release Watch reads Datadog, Prometheus, New Relic or Sentry while a flag rolls out and pauses it if a metric breaks. Free plan, hosted in the EU.

posts.name: InfluencerIQ
posts.tagline: Find, vet and measure iGaming creators
posts.description: InfluencerIQ helps licensed casino and sportsbook brands find streamers and creators by market, check sponsorship history and brand safety, run campaigns with content approval, and measure cost per FTD and ROI per creator.

posts.name: EventNoble
posts.tagline: Every local event in your Canadian city, in one place
posts.description: Local events are scattered across library, city and venue websites. EventNoble gathers concerts, comedy, meetups, food festivals, library programs and family activities in one place, updated daily. Browse by city, category or date across Canadian cities.

posts.name: SoreQen Code
posts.tagline: SoreQen Code : The AI coding Agent that checks its own work.
posts.description: SoreQen Code is an autonomous coding agent by ZorQelis AI. Describe a task and it reads your project, makes a plan, edits files, runs commands and tests, checks its own work, and tells you plainly what it did. Use it in the SoreQen desktop app or the open-source CLI, and approve steps from your phone when you are away. It runs on 18 models with one credit balance, and SoreQen Auto picks the right one for each step. Free to start.

posts.name: Agent Flock
posts.tagline: Every AI coding agent, one glance away
posts.description: A notch for your Windows desktop that shows what every Claude Code and Codex agent is doing: working, needs you, done or failed. See which one is blocked on a permission prompt without hunting through windows. Read-only, fully local, no account.

posts.name: Facts & Data
posts.tagline: Citation Authority You Own.
posts.description: FaaStr Facts & Data is first-party claim infrastructure, Built FaaStr. Capture your original stats as registered claims with dataset lineage, publish machine-readable fact pages the AI crawlers behind ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google can parse and cite, and monitor where your numbers appear — attributed or not. In private development — join the waitlist.

posts.name: AnsweredChat
posts.tagline: Website chat that turns visitors into call-back leads
posts.description: An AI webchat for business websites. When a visitor wants a call back, it takes their contact details and emails them to your team with the page and ad they came from. It answers everyone else only from facts you approve, and says so when it does not know. One line of code to install, WordPress too. We set up a free preview on your own site before you pay. $99 a month per website.

posts.name: Bloop 2.0
posts.tagline: Music-reactive visuals with flowing color themes for Mac
posts.description: Give your music a different mood. Bloop 2.0 adds four flowing color themes, adjustable intensity and colored reflections across eight reactive skins. Bring the themes into MP3-to-video exports, or let your desktop show through Glass while you listen. For Apple Silicon Macs. Free options, no subscription.

posts.name: ProjectLink
posts.tagline: Programme, trackers and dashboards for construction projects
posts.description: ProjectLink is project controls for construction teams: a programme with baselines, linked trackers (engineering, procurement, QA/QC, store), BOQ, invoices and cash flow, plus dashboards that escalate late items before they become problems.

posts.name: TypoGrammar Translate
posts.tagline: Free Offline Translator for Windows
posts.description: TypoGrammar Translate is a free, open-source offline translator for Windows 10 and 11. Translate between English and 9 languages on your PC with no cloud, no…

posts.name: Laterculus: Learn a word a day
posts.tagline: Learn on Lock & Home Screen
posts.description: Laterculus is a widget-first language app, made to never be opened. One word and one sentence, right on your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Every glance at your phone becomes a small moment with a new language. A few seconds here, a few seconds there. Word by word, sentence by sentence, at your own pace, until the language is simply part of what you know. Add the widget once, and let Laterculus do the rest.
